title: The Uncut Notch

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: You can lay your thumb on the notch you have not cut and leave it lying there. The knife knows where it was; the wood keeps its place; and nothing is owed for the touching.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the kindling, told in the last tend of Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and twenty-four to three hundred and twenty-six days, six months and one hundred and forty-four to one hundred and forty-six days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register takes the body in its old order each morning — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that the composed face is not composure; he knows the infant's want of the crust and the wiped thread is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid. Five arithmetics of the year stand behind one printed figure: one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer. The staying at the inch of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 remain two objects on two places with a finger between them; the handful let fall at the rack end on Bone 22 remains one object on its own place, not made again. Four held changes stay on four places and are not a rule; nine stoppings stay nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; nine record-first hands stay nine with Ilva's strip unread in her sleeve and no tenth.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fifth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{324}{Bone 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 222 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 90. Carry 323 to 324 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-four days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 20's reading comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and the reading is not re-read. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot with the thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack showing, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure — and lifts no handful — and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. Widow's mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings; five openings in five months are five and not a rule, and the sixth stands at Ash 2 far off (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told; the told figure beside the paid. File open on the towel with every gap left gap; the staying and the early letting-go two objects with a finger between and neither repeated; the handful one object and not repeated; four held changes on four places and not a rule; five arithmetics in Berr Clay's locked box with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the two small objects or his gaps — edges nearly touch, the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Bone 30 (Day 329) stands five mornings ahead and is not brought early. Answer 223: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; borrows no house count and supplies no payer (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Last Tend Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 324, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the rack end, the yard well and its flat stone, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the trough's skin of ice; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no figure spoken over the going (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere, not a sign; the skin on the trough; the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders answers the price with the weather, which carried the snow and can carry the price, and goes toward the clay road with nobody weighing the hare and nobody opening a slate; another with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot, and the pot, being a pot, says nothing. The boy reads both as a chart left blank where the number should stand and enters neither (T077). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned beneath the wool and given no figure; her fingers go in and come out and do not close, and no handful is lifted (T077 held, T060/T086). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence where it cannot, knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the sentence about an ear under this roof to the word that would call the loan and stops there as the remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding what little light there is, stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006, T062). At the shed's edge Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent little finger from men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey, speaks to the wheel before any person — It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady — says You'll do to a pot, knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from a High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot; one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Garl stays in objects, name unspoken 324 days, tile debt uncalled. Sella sets him on his bed under the roof at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft; a sound from above and behind only and no interior entered. Answer 224 at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go is neither early again nor stayed, and the hand does not stay (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Sixth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{325}{Bone 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 25 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the handful is not made again, and Bone 30 (Day 329) is four mornings ahead and not brought early. Carry 324 to 325 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-five days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot buys nothing at two inches of air while the infant's want of the crust and the wiped thread is louder, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar intact: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, intake-hold-and-letting-go counted toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted on the thumb where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful lifted, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched at a morning and a hearth (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell in its square beside the told; told figure beside the paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; staying and early letting-go two objects, neither repeated; handful one object, not repeated; four held changes on four places and not a rule; 224 honest answers on the sixth. Five arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box with one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the two small objects or his gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Answer 225: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Thumb on the Seventh Notch
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Bone 26 through the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him at the half-pace and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; the dressed grain lies turned under wool and given no figure (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held, T077). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the dry cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft. A woman asks what the firings of Bone have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal under the loaf shelf, the cord, the open slate a pace away, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice (T080 advanced, not paid). The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and files **no tenth hand**: Ilva's ninth stays nine on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, nine objects and not a rule, she is not made a reader of her own keeping, and she is not Marra, the soft-handed man, the soft-cuffed clerk, Hessa, the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, the woman whose voice came over the boards or the Drawing collector, and is joined to none. Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather: a woman with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot, and the pot says nothing (T077). At the wheel-shed Jorra's men unnamed come low before first grey and get no name; he parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note known three turns ahead from a High Kiln master, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062). **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082, T060/T086):** at the kindling, when Tarn sets the small knife back at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a man's hand could also slip it off, his thumb travels up the worn mark to the seventh notch at the lip beyond it, the one the house cannot check, and rests there for the length of one breath. He does not cut it, does not count it, does not say the sentence that would call the loan, and does not spend the Seed 16 breath; then he draws the thumb back down to the six where the house can check and tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count. The boy reads a hand laid on a place a man has decided not to open and left there unopened, and files it on a place of its own with a finger between it and the nine stoppings, between it and the four held changes, between it and the handful and between it and his own gaps. It is not a tenth stopping — no sentence was brought to the word that would call the loan — not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a near-full answer, not a mending and not a rule; no payer stands to it, and it is not made again on Bone 27. The remembered ninth stopping stays nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the loan uncalled, the knife where it can be checked, the unforged collector sentence lying beside the seventh, the Ash worked into the knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and the pale clip-ring holding what little light there is. The holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate at five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; row at five askings with one shaping and no witness and expressly no sixth asking; well-saying at three shapings with Hessa's eighth hand on its own place and a finger between; shut-room tellings at two; three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; five openings in five months with the next far off; seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth; heard bell in its square beside the told; no collector up or down the clay road (T101, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082, T036/T076, T006, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T058/T079). Garl stays in objects, name unspoken 325 days, tile debt uncalled. Answer 226 at the close: small intake let go whole on the river's note, neither stayed nor early.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{326}{Bone 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 25 or 26 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the handful is not made again and the thumb's resting on the seventh notch is not made again, and Bone 30 (Day 329) is three mornings ahead and not brought early. Carry 325 to 326 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-six days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty-six days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust, unnamed gap, thread, cold, the waiting afterdrop; the composed face that is not composure; the infant's want louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, lifts the twice-mended pot with the thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and both proverbs to pot and fire with the crack showing, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf and the two gaps unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, turns the dressed grain under the wool with the lighter touch and no figure and lifts no handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood; overhead four nails, four and a knot; through the finger's-width door water over water — three counts in three places that do not become one, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T088, T061/T082). Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; staying and early letting-go two objects on two places with a finger between and neither repeated; handful one object and not repeated; the thumb's resting one object and not repeated; four held changes on four places and not a rule; 225 honest answers on the sixth. Five arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects or his gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Answer 227: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Three Mornings Short
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 326, Bone 27, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, never figures, and the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077). Hunts and repairs as directions: a woman with a basket of kindling asks what the seventh year will want when it comes, and two men say the thaw will be early and late; Tarn says Yes, house to each and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T036/T076). The chapter's held movement is checked and left on its own place: the thumb that rested on the seventh notch at the kindling on Bone 26 is one object, not made again on Bone 27, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change and not a rule, with a finger between it and the nine stoppings, between it and the four held changes, between it and the handful and between it and the boy's gaps — a touch that took nothing and paid nothing, kept because it was true and not because it bought anything (T036/T076/T006, T060/T086, T061/T082). The handful let fall at the rack end on Bone 22 stays one object and is not made again; the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stay two objects and are not made again. Five arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or the boy's gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The whole holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate five, row five askings with one shaping and no witness, well-saying three shapings with Hessa's eighth hand kept apart, nine hands with Ilva's ninth in a sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, two shut-room tellings, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, five openings in five months with the next far off at Ash 2, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, heard bell in its square beside the told, no collector up or down the clay road (T080, T101, T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082, T036/T076, T006, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T058/T079). Garl stays in objects, name unspoken 326 days, tile debt uncalled, no lesson made (T009/T013/T092). At the shed's edge and the damper Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note he knows three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and keeps he's not Vail sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). Sella sets him on his bed under the roof at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft; a sound from above and behind only and no interior entered. At the very end of the day, with the yard quiet and the river's note at its lowest under the finger's-width door, answer 228: hand up an inch, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down and laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed. Exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air; borrowing no house count, supplying no payer, laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps. Two hundred and twenty-eight honest answers stand on the sixth; no doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Close on the count: 326 exact, complete, unspent, spoken by nobody; six months and one hundred and forty-six days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid the same number with payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same; nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended; the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do, bought nothing, and going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn, three mornings short of the month's third and last reading and not brought into a day that has not earned it (T071/T072, T088).
